UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information storing authentication details and metadata

id.description: Unique identifier corresponding to Firebase Auth UID

UserStudyData.title: UserStudyData
UserStudyData.description: Comprehensive study state including study programs, subjects, topics, preferences, blocked calendar events, and pomodoro logs

programs.description: List of academic study programs with years, subjects, notes, and topics

preferences.description: User study preferences including 52/17 pomodoro config, study days, and notification options

blockedEvents.description: Calendar blocked time slots for appointments or personal events

chunkCount.description: Number of overflow data chunk documents in studyData subcollection when programs payload is large

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based index of a studyData chunk document

dataChunk.description: Serialized JSON slice of study programs for multi-document storage under the 1 MiB limit

PomodoroRoom.title: PomodoroRoom
PomodoroRoom.description: Synchronized virtual Pomodoro study room allowing multiple authenticated users to study together in real time

id.description: Unique room invite code and document ID

name.description: Display name of the virtual study room

subjectLabel.description: Optional subject or study goal label for the room

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator/host

hostName.description: Public display name of the room host

isPublic.description: Whether the room appears in the open rooms directory or is joinable only by code

isRunning.description: Whether the shared timer is currently ticking

shortBreakMinutes.description: Configured short break duration in minutes

longBreakMinutes.description: Configured long break duration in minutes

pausedRemainingSeconds.description: Remaining seconds when the timer is paused

targetEndTimeMs.description: UTC epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the running phase finishes (0 when paused)

cycleCount.description: Completed focus cycles in this room session

status.description: Lifecycle state of the study room

PomodoroRoomParticipant.title: PomodoroRoomParticipant
PomodoroRoomParticipant.description: Active student participating in a synchronized Pomodoro study room

currentTask.description: Subject or topic the participant is currently studying

PomodoroRoomNote.title: PomodoroRoomNote
PomodoroRoomNote.description: Lightweight motivation note or milestone check-in inside a synchronized study room

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user document containing private profile information

/users/{userId}/studyData/{docId}.description: User study data state for persistent synchronization across devices

/pomodoroRooms/{roomId}.description: Synchronized virtual Pomodoro study rooms shared across authenticated participants

/pomodoroRooms/{roomId}/participants/{pa.description: Active participants studying inside a specific Pomodoro room

/pomodoroRooms/{roomId}/messages/{messag.description: Motivation notes and quick check-ins inside a Pomodoro room
